title: DOW-UAP-PR098, "UFOs in formation over Persian Gulf?"
what_is_it: A declassified infrared video recorded by a U.S. military sensor platform, released as part of the PURSUE collection in response to a congressional request for UAP-related records.
core_summary: This is a 17-minute infrared video originally uploaded to a classified network in October 2019, captured by a U.S. military platform operating in the CENTCOM area of responsibility (Persian Gulf region). The video shows an area of contrast being tracked and zoomed in on by the sensor. AARO identified it among materials responsive to a March 2026 congressional request but notes many such materials lack a substantiated chain of custody.
interpretation_warnings: The video description text is truncated mid-sentence at the 01:59 mark, so content beyond that timestamp is undocumented in available metadata.
No extracted text from the source document itself — all facts derive from CSV metadata and the video description field.
AARO uses hedging language ('likely derived from'), indicating the provenance is assessed but not confirmed.
The materials explicitly lack a substantiated chain of custody, meaning the origin and handling of this video cannot be independently verified.
The uploader-defined title ('UFOs in formation over Persian Gulf?') is user-generated and does not represent an official assessment.
The video description refers only to 'an area of contrast', not to identifiable objects or craft.
